bullets: Un sistema rápido cruza el lunes con humedad y dinámica limitadas: solo chubascos ligeros y acumulaciones mínimas en terreno alto.
Una cresta de alta presión trae tiempo seco desde el martes hasta al menos media semana.
Para Thanksgiving y el fin de semana sigue posible un patrón más activo, pero los ensambles no coinciden (confianza baja).

sections.Key Messages:
- Snow comes to an end bringing clear and dry conditions for
  Tuesday and Wednesday
- Active weather remains possible late Thanksgiving week, but
  some details still remain uncertain. Stay tuned for updates to
  timing and impacts as they become available.
sections.Discussion:
Issued at 906 PM MST Mon Nov 23 2026
CALM AND DRY CONDITIONS EXPECTED TUESDAY AND WEDNESDAY
Snow showers are coming to an end over the central and southern
mountains. Skies will clear while fog begins to develop in
mountain valleys. A fast moving ridge will develop in the wake
of this system. Clear and dry conditions are expected for
Tuesday and Wednesday as this ridge moves over the region.
ANOTHER ROUND OF SNOW EXPECTED AFTER THANKSGIVING
After this ridge moves through, deterministic guidance is coming
into better agreement that flow starts to split by Thursday. A
ridge begins developing over SoCal which will bring a cutoff low
to our south while another powerful system moves to our north
and east. A continuation of dry conditions with above normal
temperatures is expected for Thanksgiving as both systems move
away from our CWA. By Friday, the SoCal ridge breaks down and
another system approaches our area. Flow turns northwesterly
and with it, there's an increased chance of snowfall over the
Park Range on Friday into Saturday. Confidence is still low on
how much snow will fall as some details remain uncertain. This
is especially true if strong northwest flow sets up further
north. If you are planning on traveling during this time, be
prepared for the possibility of difficult travel conditions,
especially over the northern Colorado mountains. There is also a
possibility of impacts south of the Park Range but confidence
remains low on the exact details. After Friday and Saturday,
guidance becomes more uncertain with multiple different
scenarios. There is potential for the pattern to remain active
into Sunday and early next week.
sections.Aviation:
Issued at 1038 PM MST Mon Nov 23 2026
Skies are clearing from west to east. Fog and low stratus could
develop across the lower valleys overnight, especially in areas
that saw precipitation today. KMTJ, KTEX, KDRO, and KGUC have
fog/low stratus in TAFs. Occasional drops to MVFR/IFR remain
possible in areas of fog. Outside of the impacts from fog, VFR
conditions will prevail with light terrain driven winds.
